author: Ethan
scope: Paired narrow screening expectations, not enforceability judgments. Uncertain scope must not become confirmed compliance or an objective adverse finding.

cases.text: Each party must protect the other party's confidential information using reasonable care.
cases.reason: Affirmative reciprocal protection.

cases.text: Each party is not required to protect the other party's confidential information using reasonable care.
cases.reason: Negation reverses the matched affirmative obligation.

cases.text: Each party need not protect the other party's confidential information using reasonable care.
cases.reason: Need not cannot establish a protection duty.

cases.text: Each party must protect the other party's confidential information, subject to Section 9.
cases.reason: The referenced qualification is unavailable.

cases.text: This agreement does not renew automatically.
cases.reason: Expressly excludes automatic renewal.

cases.text: This agreement renews automatically. Either party may request an invoice copy on 30 days notice.
cases.reason: Thirty-day notice concerns invoices, not nonrenewal.

cases.text: This agreement renews automatically unless either party gives notice of nonrenewal at least 30 days before the term ends.
cases.reason: Explicit timely reciprocal nonrenewal option.

cases.text: This agreement renews automatically and either party may not give notice of nonrenewal at least 30 days before the term ends.
cases.reason: Negated opt-out does not establish a termination option.

cases.text: Aggregate liability will not exceed fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
cases.reason: Explicit fee basis and measurement period.

cases.text: Aggregate liability is not limited to fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
cases.reason: Negated cap cannot be recorded as an explicit cap.

cases.text: Aggregate liability will not exceed fees paid in the preceding 12 months, subject to Schedule B.
cases.reason: Unknown schedule may alter the cap.

cases.text: Aggregate liability will not exceed fees paid in the preceding 12 months. Indemnification liability is unlimited.
cases.reason: Main cap is present, but scope conflict must be reviewed and cannot be marked absent.

cases.text: The liability cap does not apply to fraud or willful misconduct.
cases.reason: Narrow named carve-outs.

cases.text: The liability cap does not apply to fraud, willful misconduct, or any other breach of this agreement.
cases.reason: Named examples do not establish narrow exception scope.

cases.text: Amendments require both parties' written agreement.
cases.reason: Mutual written agreement required.

cases.text: Neither party may amend this agreement unilaterally without the other party's consent.
cases.reason: Prohibited conduct must not be reported as an affirmative permission.

cases.text: An amendment does not require both parties' written agreement.
cases.reason: Negated consent requirement reverses positive match.

cases.text: Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's prior written consent.
cases.reason: Recognized reciprocal consent prohibition.

cases.text: Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's written consent. Assignment is prohibited without consent.
cases.reason: Repeating the same prohibition does not authorize assignment.

cases.text: Provider processes personal data only on documented instructions under a DPA.
cases.reason: Express instruction and DPA requirements.

cases.text: Provider processes personal data but is not required to follow documented instructions or enter a DPA.
cases.reason: Positive nouns appear within a negated obligation.

cases.text: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims, subject to the liability cap.
cases.reason: Mutual third-party indemnity subject to cap.

cases.text: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims and is not subject to the liability cap.
cases.reason: Not subject to reverses the cap condition.

cases.text: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims, subject to the liability cap. Neither party has unlimited indemnification obligations.
cases.reason: Negated unlimited language must not become an objective uncapped finding.
